experience.title: Data Analyst (Python, SAS, SQL)

bullets.text: Built a champion-challenger credit scoring framework on 30M+ customer records; reduced feature space from 250+ variables to 18 high-IV predictors via WOE and IV selection, achieving KS of 0.47 on holdout test set.

Engineered an ensemble model (Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression, LSTM, DSN) with boosting and bagging, improving KS from 0.47 to 0.52 over the logistic regression baseline while maintaining PSI < 0.1 for population stability.

Developed a seasonally adjusted ARIMA model incorporating macroeconomic indicators (vehicle sales, commodity indices) to forecast credit card overdrafts; achieved 27-day MAE of 0.07%, directly supporting risk provisioning decisions.
Conducted statistical validation (T-test, KS-test, Chi-square, p < 0.05) on risk data pipelines, passing acceptance criteria for a FICO bidding project.

Applied Chroma and FAISS for RAG pipeline optimization, enabling semantic search and retrieval-augmented response generation.
Fine-tuned LLMs with LoRA for Amazon product price prediction, improving accuracy by 24%.
Built feedforward neural networks from scratch with full backpropagation, achieving 84%+ accuracy via 5-fold cross-validation.
Trained multi-class classifiers on the Reuters Newswire dataset (46 categories), reaching 92%+ validation accuracy and 99.9% top-3 accuracy.

Optimized query performance through index creation and subquery-based filtering, and executed CRUD operations with cascading DELETE and conditional UPDATE across related tables.

projects.title: Cloud Security Assessment & Penetration Testing
projects.subtitle: Wireshark, Hashcat, Kali Linux, Burp Suite, Shodan, Censys, OWASP

bullets.text: Conducted passive cloud asset reconnaissance on uci.edu via certificate transparency logs, enumerating 2,080 subdomains and mapping 410 cloud assets across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Cloudflare; identified 7 high-risk publicly exposed assets.
Cracked a 500K-entry LinkedIn SHA-1 breach dataset using Hashcat with wordlist and rule-based attacks, achieving a peak recovery rate of 61.32% (306,604 hashes).

Authored a NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 aligned qualitative risk assessment for a simulated pharmaceutical company, identifying 10 enterprise security risks (7 HIGH) with a prioritized 0-365 day remediation roadmap.

Captured and analyzed HTTPS traffic with Wireshark to isolate TLS packet exchanges, and automated a 4-stage cloud recon pipeline in Python with zero external dependencies.
